verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for an online tax-filing service, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no user-configurable automation, schedule, or autonomous background run. MeinELSTER+'s 'automatische Erstellung' auto-drafts a single annual return inside a guided step-by-step flow, which is a one-off feature rather than a recurring automation the user sets up. Third-party software using the ELSTER channel is an external developer route and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
